description: Runner receipt signer trust. No signer is provisioned: enabled=false and public_keys empty. While no signer is provisioned, runner manifests cannot certify capability evidence; every capability that requires runner trust stays unevidenced and its conformance rows remain partial/open. Provisioning is out-of-band: the private signing key lives only in out-of-tree, root-owned mode-0600 forced-command infrastructure on the disposable runner VM (never printed or copied into Git); the unprivileged endpoint never signs, and the root-owned signer rebuilds and signs only manifests whose fields prove a clean pass after exact archive/tree/environment/verifier/probes passed. This repository carries only this policy and the public keys. Signer rotation is fail-closed: a manifest signed by a key that is no longer in public_keys, or claiming a foreign principal/namespace, is rejected.
